title: Destination Card Component
description: Compact card for displaying destination information

subtitle.description: Location and brief descriptor (e.g., 'Italy · Cave city')

promptInstructions: Provide the destination's title, a subtitle combining country and a brief descriptor (e.g., 'Italy · Cave city'), a duration badge (e.g., '2-3 days'), and a badge label (e.g., 'Ideal stay'). Keep all fields concise.
